system.name: MonoNN
system.one_liner: a compiler that fuses an entire neural-network inference computation into one monolithic GPU kernel

components.name: (1) Subgraph Formulation
components.role: formulates the input neural network into different subgraphs (SIS, EWS, OCS) and CI Ops for subsequent optimization

components.name: (2) Subgraph Inst. Reschedule
components.role: reschedules instructions inside subgraphs to expose hidden parallelism of memory-intensive subgraphs

components.name: (3) On-chip Resource Exploitation
components.role: optimizes on-chip resource usage (register buffering, SMEM pipelining, caching) per subgraph via pattern analysis

components.name: (4) GTB Assign & Merge
components.role: assigns and merges Global Thread Barriers across subgraphs to reduce synchronization overhead

components.name: (5) Schedule-Independent Group Tuning
components.role: tunes the best schedule for each SIS and CI Op independently

components.name: (6) Automatic Code Generation
components.role: compiles the tuned subgraphs into one executable monolithic kernel

components.name: SIS
components.role: schedule-independent subgraph, a unit MonoNN can freely reorder relative to other SIS

components.name: CI Op
components.role: compute-intensive op, a subgraph kept intact rather than split further

components.name: Monolithic Kernel
components.role: single fused GPU kernel produced by automatic code generation

flows.what: formulated SIS/EWS/OCS subgraphs and CI Ops
best schedule tuned per SIS/CI Op

content.key_idea: MonoNN compiles a neural network into one monolithic GPU kernel through six stages: formulating subgraphs, rescheduling instructions for hidden parallelism, exploiting on-chip resources, merging global thread barriers, tuning per-subgraph schedules, and generating the final fused code.
content.reading_order: Grid read column by column through six numbered panels (1)-(6): left column top-to-bottom (1)(2)(3), right column top-to-bottom (4)(5)(6), each a self-contained diagram of one compilation stage.

summary: This figure gives the end-to-end overview of MonoNN, a compiler that fuses a whole neural-network inference computation into one monolithic GPU kernel. Six numbered panels trace the pipeline: (1) Subgraph Formulation splits the network into schedule-independent (SIS), element-wise (EWS), and output-only contracted (OCS) subgraphs and compute-intensive ops (CI Op); (2) Subgraph Inst. Reschedule reorders instructions inside a subgraph to expose hidden parallelism; (3) On-chip Resource Exploitation applies register buffering, SMEM pipelining, and caching guided by pattern analysis; (4) GTB Assign & Merge reduces synchronization by merging Global Thread Barriers across subgraphs; (5) Schedule-Independent Group Tuning searches for the best schedule per SIS and CI Op; and (6) Automatic Code Generation compiles everything into the final Monolithic Kernel. A shared legend (Element-wise Op, Reduction Op, Compute-intensive Op) and running SIS1/SIS2 example tie the six panels together.
summary_zh: 该图展示MonoNN编译流程：六个编号面板依次完成子图划分、指令重调度、片上资源优化、线程屏障合并与分组调优，最终生成Monolithic Kernel。
